_comment: Pinned verified runs: each entry maps a run identifier to the commit sha and code-bundle sha that produced it. The verify script checks against this registry (via --run-id), not the working tree, so past runs stay verified after future src/ edits. bundle_sha is the first 16 chars of the sha256 of the embedded payload, exactly as printed in the kernel log.

v11.notes: R19i: the v11 matched-size grid — fresh code PROVEN, root win replicates, case crux does not move

v13.notes: v12 character-level CNN input encoder. Code proven; char vocab present in-cloud (char=82); PARITY 13,436,845/13,436,941. n=1 seed — no verdict from this run is a test.

v14.architecture: v12 char encoder + SOFT wazan->root conditioning (shared by both arms)
v14.activation_evidence: the cloud printed 13,087,021 / 13,087,117 — the CONDITIONING architecture, not the 13,436,845 / 13,436,941 of v13 — so the shared soft wazan->root branch compiled in and ran. Post-hoc evidence, not an in-notebook test: this notebook predates the forward-pass activation assertion.
v14.notes: 3-seed grid, 12 runs, 3,550 s. Treatment does NOT beat baseline on root anywhere once decoded with the trie; see CHALLENGES 2ab.

v15.bundle_sha_source: CONFIRMED against the fetched kernel log on 2026-10-11: verify_run_code.py --kernel-log dist/runs/v15/kernel_full.log --run-id v15 -> the run's code IS the pinned bundle
v15.architecture: v12 char encoder, SOFT wazan->root conditioning OFF - the CONTROL arm
v15.expected_parity_note: the NO-conditioning counts, identical to v13. If the cloud prints 13,087,021 / 13,087,117 the flag did NOT take and the control is really another conditioning run.
carries_audit_fixes: code_bundle_sha + config_sha256 + seeds + parity.tolerance/exact_match in results.json
v15.notes: VERIFIED 2026-10-11: the run's code IS the pinned bundle, and the parity printed was the NO-conditioning counts, so the flag really took. RESULT: turning the conditioning OFF moves NO root cell - every sign and every verdict identical, largest shift 0.0096, inside the seed spread - so v14's treatment root loss belongs to the shared encoder / 13k-type vocabulary / decoder, NOT to the conditioning. OFF also exposes a -4.2 pp wazan deficit vs baseline on the gold target (SEPARATED) that the conditioning had been masking. See CHALLENGES 2ac.
